name: tago
description: 버스 실시간 도착·위치 · 지하철 역·출구·시간표 · 기차 · 고속/시외버스 · 국내선 항공 · 여객선 · 카셰어링 · 공유 전동킥보드 — 국가대중교통정보센터(TAGO) 13개 서비스 통합. 버스(정류소·노선·실시간 도착·실시간 위치) · 고속버스 · 시외버스 · 열차 · 지하철(역·출구·시간표) · 국내항공 · 국내선박 · 카셰어링 · 공유 전동킥보드. 실시간 버스 도착·위치는 10~20초 갱신이고, 지하철은 실시간이 아니라 시간표(주1회 갱신)입니다 — 지하철은 정시 운행이라 시간표+현재시각으로 다음 열차가 계산됩니다. ID 는 *-search/*-list 액션이 발급하고 나머지가 소비하는 계단 구조이며, 엉뚱한 목록의 ID 를 넣으면 에러가 아니라 빈 결과가 돌아옵니다. 키 = molit·kma 와 같은 DATA_GO_KR_API_KEY.

action.description: Which TAGO operation to run. Ids are minted by the *-search / *-list actions and consumed by the others; an id from the wrong list returns an empty result rather than an error, so follow the ladder each action names.

service.description: [city-codes] Which service's 도시코드 list to read. Every service publishes its own under its own base and whether they are identical has not been measured, so read the one belonging to the service you are about to call

cityCode.description: [bus-*/train-stations/suburbs-terminals/scooters] 도시코드. ⚠️ TWO DIFFERENT NUMBERINGS share this name: for every bus, train and suburbs action it is the 도시코드 from the `city-codes` action (Daejeon = 25); for `scooters` it is the 지역번호 from `scooter-providers` and the city-codes list does not apply

nodeId.description: [bus-arrivals/bus-arrival-route/bus-position-at-stop/bus-stop-routes] 정류소ID, e.g. DJB8001793 — from bus-stop-search or bus-stop-nearby

nodeNm.description: [bus-stop-search/ports] Stop or port name to search for

nodeNo.description: [bus-stop-search] 정류소번호 (the number posted on the sign, not the id)

routeNo.description: [bus-route-search] 노선번호 (the number on the front of the bus)

depTmnCd.description: [express-destinations/express-arrivals] 출발터미널코드, a bare number like 010 — from express-terminals-arr. ⚠️ NOT interchangeable with depTerminalId, which is the prefixed form (NAEK010) used by express-schedule

depTerminalId.description: [express-schedule/suburbs-schedule] 출발터미널ID, a prefixed id like NAEK010 or NAI0671801 — from express-terminals or suburbs-terminals. ⚠️ NOT the bare depTmnCd used by the arrival actions

depPlandTime.description: [*-schedule] Departure date YYYYMMDD. train-schedule treats it as today when omitted; the express and suburbs schedules require it

subwayStationName.description: [subway-stations] Station name to search for, e.g. 서울역

zoneAddr.description: [carshare-by-address] Address to search near, e.g. 서울 중구

radius.description: [carshare-nearby] Search radius in km, up to 10

cityName.description: [scooter-providers] 시군단위 지역명, e.g. 세종. Omit for all regions

items.description: Result rows. Field names follow the vendor: the four bus services answer all-lowercase (routeid, nodenm, gpslati), the rest camelCase (terminalId, depPlandTime)

output.description: Every action returns {items, totalCount}. An empty items list means the ids were well-formed but matched nothing — the note names which list each id should have come from.
